shortDescription: At least 590 foreign nationals from 39 countries are missing in Nepal after the devastating flood that struck the Himalayan nation last week, the Nepali foreign ministry said on Monday.So far, 323 foreign nationals have been rescued, spokesperson Lok Bahadur Chhetri said.
